hypothesis_text: When the 1-hour account long/short ratio z-score on midcap altcoins (BNB, SOL, XRP) deviates sharply into the tails (|z| > 1.3), retail sentiment becomes heavily crowded and overextended. When aggressive taker flow begins to push against this crowded sentiment (gate_opposite_side on taker_buy_ratio_1h), or when price is extended beyond 2 sigma of its 24-hour moving average (gate_tail on trend_sma_ratio_24h), market makers and informed traders absorb the imbalance, forcing retail positions into exhaustion and liquidations. This exhaustion dynamic drives a systematic mean-reverting price correction in the direction opposite to the crowded retail stance over 1h to 4h horizons (predicted_sign = -1).
narrative:
Retail traders on high-leverage perpetual swap venues frequently engage in short-horizon herd behavior, rapidly piling into directional bets following intraday momentum. The 1-hour account long/short ratio z-score (long_short_ratio_zscore_1h) captures this acute positioning surge before it can be reflected in slower multi-day sentiment metrics. At extreme levels (|z| > 1.3, representing the outer ~20% of distribution), retail account positioning becomes highly fragile and liquidity-dependent.

The trade unwind is triggered by two complementary economic mechanisms:
First, aggressive market orders from informed participants and market makers entering against the crowd (measured by gate_opposite_side on taker_buy_ratio_1h). When retail is heavily long but taker volume turns net selling, retail buyers run out of capital to absorb the bids, initiating a cascade of stop-losses and margin reductions. High and low gates on taker_buy_ratio_1h serve as controls to isolate the asymmetric impact of flow opposition from generic volume spikes.
Second, 24-hour price stretch (measured by gate_tail on trend_sma_ratio_24h) acts as an essential momentum control. In an overextended trend, prices have already consumed short-term liquidity buffers, magnifying the impact of inventory rebalancing by liquidity providers.

Because retail crowding is symmetric across both excessive optimism (long crowding, z > 1.3) and panic (short crowding, z < -1.3), the locked two-sided candidate condition identifies both overbought and oversold states, predicting forward return reversal relative to the sentiment direction (predicted_sign = -1).
research_rationale:
Data & Dispersion:
The anchor signal XL_midcap_alt_355643d3ac99 is a basket-wide candidate locked on midcap_alt (BNB, SOL, XRP) at 15m cadence over 430 calendar days (123,840 bars). The expression abs(long_short_ratio_zscore_1h) > 1.3 captures 25,624 bars (20.7% match rate) across 22,170 episodes, spanning 430 independent daily event clusters. The matched bars exhibit near-perfect symmetry: 12,828 positive vs 12,796 negative, confirming balanced bidirectional coverage. Projected T1 scored days reach 275 days, well exceeding the 250-day T1.11 minimum requirement. The 1h autocorrelation of long_short_ratio_zscore_1h is negligible (0.0138), demonstrating that hourly sentiment spikes represent independent episodic shocks rather than long-memory persistent states.

Prior & Ledger Alignment:
The authored composition plan incorporates four terms:
1. gate_opposite_side on taker_buy_ratio_1h: Directly follows the gene prior for sentiment_crowding (role: trigger, direction: opposite_side, rationale: aggressors against the crowded side initiate the unwind). In gene_knowledge, this role has n=123 trials, confidence 'sufficient', shrink_weight 0.860.
2. gate_high on taker_buy_ratio_1h and (3) gate_low on taker_buy_ratio_1h: Committed as required controls for the side-tied gate_opposite_side, ensuring that the asymmetric opposition effect is disentangled from generic taker activity levels.
4. gate_tail on trend_sma_ratio_24h: Follows the prior for sentiment_crowding (role: stretch, direction: tail, rationale: momentum control separating crowd unwinds from persistent trends, n=48, confidence 'sufficient', shrink_weight 0.706).
Funding rate (funding_rate_zscore_30d) was explored in the prior table but deliberately omitted from composition_plan because probe_partner diagnostics showed it projects only 22-127 T1 days (below the 250-day floor), which would cause a mandatory gate refusal.

Addressing Alpha Cemetery Kill Codes:
The alpha cemetery records 1,591 historical trials for long_short_ratio_zscore_1h, with dominant kill code T0.04-IC-STAT (1,161 trials) and T1.10-ICIR (187 trials). Unconditioned continuous sentiment signals fail T0.04 because trading on ordinary non-crowded bars dilutes the signal with market noise. By locking an explicit threshold (|z| > 1.3) via expression_gate and conditioning with gate_opposite_side and gate_tail, the design restricts trading to high-conviction exhaustion bars, directly boosting effective t-statistics and stabilizing fold-to-fold ICIR. Furthermore, cemetery records show that survival was highest at 30m-2h horizons (surviving 39 trials), whereas 4h-1d had 0 survivals; our predicted_horizon_band of 1h to 4h focuses on the exact 1h-2h window where sentiment reversal is statistically operative.

Search Scope:
Search scope 'full' is selected to allow the automatic grid and mutator to explore orthogonal two- and three-operand couplings with the anchor's seeded templates, while committed terms provide the primary falsifiable hypothesis.
